newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY.

text.p: BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0900/0800 GMT).
- Commissioner Oreja communication on exclusive transmission of sports events.

THE HAGUE (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner van den Broek attends Troika (past, present and future EU presidencies) EU-Ukraine meeting; meets Dutch State Secretary for European Affairs Michiel Patijn.

NOORDWIJK, Netherlands (EXPANDED ITEM) - Informal Justice and Home Affairs Council (and Thursday). Main discussions focus on the fight against organised crime, third pillar issues and the situation of the inter-governmental conference (IGC).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
Meeting with the judges of the

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "What could be the real priorities of energy policy in the EU?" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is MEP Wim Van Velzen. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner van den Broek meet Soros Foundation Chairman Georges Soros.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Audiovisual Eureka and European Audiovisual Observatory Chairman Jose-Maria Oterto hold news conference (1300/1200 GMT). Venue: Borschette Centre. Contact: Audiovisual Eureka (322) 538 0455.
BRUSSELS - European Investment Bank (EIB) President Brian Unwin holds news conference at 1000/0900 GMT. Venue: Eurovillage Hotel. Contact: EIB by fax (352) 43 79 31 89.

BRUSSELS - The European Cosmetic Toiletry and Perfumery Association (COLIPA) holds conference (0815/0715 GMT). Agenda includes: scientific and environmental issues; socio-economic issues; regulatory affairs. Venue: Conrad Hotel. Contact: COLIPA (322) 227 6610.

BRUSSELS - IBC Conferences Ltd. holds conference on "European air transport services and airports" (0900/0800 GMT) (and Friday). Speakers include: DG VII Head of Unit Federik Sorensen; European Air Shippers Council Brussels Secretary General Christopher Welsh; DG IV Head of Unit Serge Durande. Venue: Radisson SAS Hotel. Contact: IBC Conferences Ltd. (44) 171 453 2711.
THE HAGUE (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok meets Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Trade Union Confederation (ETUC) holds news conference on "The situation in Serbia" (1030/0930 GMT). Venue: International Trade Union House, 155 Blvd. Emile Jacqmain. Contact: ETUC (322) 224 0411.
